title: Indifferentiable Schemes in the [2, 3) Rate Gap
summary: The rate range from 2 up to but excluding 3 has no known constructions or lower bounds; the open task is to bridge the gap by finding either.

formal_statement.body: No constructions or lower bounds are known for indifferentiable schemes with rate $r \in [2,3)$. The open problem is to bridge this gap by constructing such schemes or proving lower bounds for them.

scope.domain: Indifferentiability of cryptographic schemes, with structural questions about rates, constructions, and lower bounds.
parameters: rate r, specifying the scheme's rate
scope.unresolved_remainder: Bridge the gap by constructing indifferentiable schemes with rate r in [2,3) or proving lower bounds for them.

progress.summary: The source presents the gap in its limitations and future-work discussion, stating that neither constructions nor lower bounds are known and that bridging it is left for future work.
citation_labels: Manuel Barbosa et al., Indifferentiable Authenticated Encryption
